hud.computeHint: Skip the animation: compute the outcome of these settings right away.

panel.title: Intersection {{id}}
panel.changed: Settings changed: press Restart to run from 0:00 with the new settings.
panel.linkedFixed: Symmetric junction: the coupling is fixed in this level

crash.title: Crash!
crash.body: At intersection {{id}} crossing traffic drove onto a blocked junction.
crash.causeQueue: The red vehicle was stuck in a queue towards intersection {{id}}.
crash.causeQueueExit: The red vehicle was stuck behind a queue.
crash.causeLight: The red vehicle was waiting for red at intersection {{id}} while still on the junction.
crash.causeUnknown: The red vehicle did not clear the junction.
crash.marked: The amber vehicle hit it on green; both are marked on the map.

menu.tagline: Tune the traffic lights and get every car out of town as fast as possible.
menu.fpsHint: Frame rate while running. Auto: 30 on phones/tablets, 60 on desktop. Idle always drops to 5 fps to save energy.
menu.iosHint: On iPhone/iPad: tap Share in Safari (the square with the arrow) and choose 'Add to Home Screen'. Stoplicht then opens full screen, also offline.
menu.insecureHint: Installing as an app needs a secure connection (https). Open stoplicht.com in Chrome or Edge and choose 'Install'.
menu.manualHint: This browser offers no install button. In Chrome or Edge: open the browser menu (⋮) and choose 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen'.

editor.title: Level editor

hint.road: Drag across the map to draw a road (horizontal or vertical). Intersections and spawn points are derived automatically.
hint.erase: Click a road tile to erase it.
hint.direction: Click a road: two-way → one-way → reversed → two-way.
hint.inspect: Click an intersection to edit its default settings.

editor.name: Name
editor.perPoint: Per spawn point (click for the list)
editor.noSpawnsHere: No spawns at this point yet. Add a series or click in the timeline.
editor.timelineHint: Click an empty spot in a row to add a car (shift = truck), drag a dot to shift its time, click a dot to edit, shift-click to select. Click a label or a spawn point on the map for the full list. Ctrl/⌘+Z undoes.
editor.newLevelBody: The current level ({{roads}} roads, {{spawns}} spawns) is replaced by an empty grid. This cannot be undone.
editor.gridHint: 3 to 40 tiles; 1 tile = 8 m. Adjustable later under 'Level'.

play.noEditorLevel: There is no level in the editor to test.

hints.level1: Tap the junction. Far more cars arrive from north and south than from east and west: give ↕ more green than ↔ and press Start, or ⚡ Compute for the outcome without waiting.
hints.level2: Two junctions and a stream of cars from west to east. At junction B, set the Offset so its green starts slightly later than at A: a green wave. Copy and paste (⧉) saves work.
